description:
`Interactive.run/1` currently relies on `Terminal.terminate/2`
to call `RawMode.exit()`. If the main receive loop raises or
exits via a linked crash before `GenServer.stop(terminal)` runs,
the tty stays in raw mode and the user's shell is broken until
they `reset`.

Fix: wrap the body of `run/1` (from session start through the
loop) in a `try/rescue/after` that *always* calls
`RawMode.exit()` and clears the cursor/paste/focus escape
sequences. Also trap exits in the runner process so a linked
child crash (e.g. Renderer, FSM) doesn't bypass cleanup.

Mirrors upstream pi-mono's Tui shutdown path
(`tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/terminal.ts` L266-307 — restore
raw-mode state, disable bracketed paste, pause stdin).

TDD:
- Inject a raw_mode_fn that counts enter/exit calls. Have
  Interactive.run/1 raise mid-loop via a test-only key or a
  send-induced exception. Assert raw_mode_fn was called with
  :exit even on the crash path.
- Assert a child crash (linked Renderer going down abnormally)
  still triggers the cleanup.
title: Crash-safe tty restoration in Interactive.run/1
